key_points.text: Hello, I'm Lauren Richardson, and this is the A16Z Journal Club, our podcast where we cover recent scientific advances, why they matter.
key_points.evidence_quote: Hello, I'm Lauren Richardson, and this is the A16Z Journal Club, our podcast where we cover recent scientific advances, why they matter, and how to take them from proof of principle to practice.

key_points.text: In this snack size episode, A16Z general partners VJ Pande and Jorge Condi.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this snack size episode, A16Z general partners VJ Pande and Jorge Condi, join me to discuss an opinion piece published in Nature Review's Drug Discovery called Breaking Ehrum's Law.

key_points.text: Erem's Law is Moore's Law spelled backwards.
key_points.evidence_quote: Erem's Law is Moore's Law spelled backwards.

key_points.text: Whereas Moore's Law describes technologies becoming exponentially faster and cheaper over time.
key_points.evidence_quote: Whereas Moore's Law describes technologies becoming exponentially faster and cheaper over time, Eroom's Law describes the trend of drug development becoming exponentially more and more expensive over time.
